assumptions: The caller read the paper and judged that it reports the hypothesis; the engine does not read papers.
limits: Confirms only one of the papers the run's own literature check returned (run_discovery_programme with check_literature).
bio.jane/contract.noScientificClaim: Records a reader's judgement in a run file; computes nothing.
bio.jane/contract.question: Has a paper someone read already reported this supported hypothesis?

description: Record that a person read one paper a literature check returned for a supported hypothesis and that it reports the finding: the hypothesis becomes known in the run's ledger, citing that paper, and the run file is sealed again.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

hypothesis.description: the supported hypothesis the paper reports, by id.

paper.description: the paper, by its PMID or DOI as the check returned it.

run.description: the run file whose literature check returned the paper.

name: confirm_literature_hit

known.description: the hypothesis's literature record: status known, the citation, and the query and results that found it

run.description: the whole program as a sealed jane.research-run file: the ledger, every corpus input pinned by SHA-256, the last attempt at each hypothesis. Pass it back to continue
